claims.assertion: Gosia says she chose Earth to support humanity and preserve its perceived connection to Source.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as personal reflection.

claims.assertion: She believes spiritual growth need not require severe suffering, though humans may still create difficult challenges.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: Personal view, not attributed Taygetan doctrine.

claims.assertion: Gosia says duality defines 3D–5D experience, making liberation difficult, while questioning whether souls want to leave.
claims.speaker: Gosia

claims.assertion: She describes starseeds as taking a dual role: experiencing Earth while sustaining a higher perspective for others.
claims.speaker: Gosia
